svg.title: Commit City — twelve months of contributions as a skyline
svg.desc: The real GitHub contribution calendar for the last 12 months drawn as a synthwave city: one building per day, its height the contributions that day, weeks running left to right and weekdays receding into the city. 2,376 contributions over 174 active days; the tallest tower is the peak day, 104 on Jul 4; longest streak 22 days. The buildings rise from the grid, a striped sun sets behind them, the floor scrolls toward the viewer and light trails cross the sky.
